channel.title: Nature
channel.description: Nature is the foremost international weekly scientific journal in the world and is the flagship journal for Nature Portfolio. It publishes the finest peer-reviewed research in all fields of science and technology on the basis of its originality, importance, interdisciplinary interest, timeliness, accessibility, elegance and surprising conclusions. Nature publishes landmark papers, award winning news, leading comment and expert opinion on important, topical scientific news and events that enable readers to share the latest discoveries in science and evolve the discussion amongst the global scientific community.

item.title: [8] Chiral superfluorescence from perovskite superlattices at room temperature
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Susanne F. Yelin, Mingjie Li

Authors: Qi Wei, Jonah S. Peter, Hui Ren, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Chiral optical phenomena in quantum materials (perovskites), relevant to electronic structure/topology.

Tags: #quantummaterials #perovskite #chiral #optics

Abstract: Nature, Published online: 03 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10637-x Chiral perovskite superlattices exhibit room-temperature circularly polarized superfluorescence, with emission intensity and polarization controllable by weak magnetic fields.

item.content:encoded:

Tags: #topological #quantumcomputing #Majorana

Abstract: Nature, Published online: 03 June 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01788-y The tech giant says it will make ‘topological’ quantum computers that can be scaled up faster than competing technologies.
